title: FLAT INVERT  day=black, night=white, null=grey. see the rays.
flat_page: no depth theater. no cards-as-furniture. one plane. the invert lives on the plane.

day.why: to SEE the sun you need the void. rays become visible against black. day is not 'light page'  day is the solar instrument.
day.shows: primary rays · hard terminator on the planet

night.why: night as print on snow. dark marks on light. moonlight / reflection logic inverted from the usual theme.
night.shows: soft sun opposite · backscatter hops readable as ink

null.why: the invert BETWEEN day and night. neither void nor snow. the reflecting pool.

the_invert_allows.sun_rays: trace from sun disc through space to planet lit face
the_invert_allows.backscatter: bounce off planet toward viewer and other spheres (moon, companion)
the_invert_allows.other_spheres: receive faint direct + planetary backscatter  same physics as pollen cross-domain

tie.pollen: ray = photon in flight. backscatter = pollen we read on their legs / they read on ours.
tie.chromatograph: day/night/null are three detector gains on the same flat column.
tie.Yellowstone: painted rock under black sky (day space) or white snow (night print).
